bilingual.notes: 14 DE Admin Code 1561 Bilingual Teacher Standard Certificate; ACTFL OPI Advanced Mid in target language; Praxis ESOL #5362 (149).

eld.notes: 14 DE Admin Code 1562 Teacher of English Learners; English proficiency required (ACTFL Advanced Mid OPI/WPT or English-medium U.S. degree); Praxis ESOL #5362 (149).

sei.notes: Delaware lists Sheltered English Instruction (SIOP) as one EL service model; no statewide SEI endorsement mandate for all teachers.

history.title: Delaware adopts the State Seal of Biliteracy
history.description: The Delaware General Assembly enacted SB 119 (148th GA, 2017) creating a State Seal of Biliteracy for high-school graduates demonstrating proficiency in English plus one or more additional world languages. DOE administers the seal through districts and charters.

history.title: Baseline coding (Leider, Colombo & Nerlino, 2021)
history.description: Initial coding of the SEA's bilingual, ELD/ESL, and SEI credentials, professional teaching standards, and EL-population data. Captured Oct–Dec 2019 for the EPAA 29(100) document analysis; this row is the as-of-2019 snapshot against which subsequent verifications are diffed.

history.title: Delaware DOE issues updated English Learner Guidebook
history.description: DDOE published the January 2024 update to the English Learner Guidebook, the operative state guidance on EL identification, programming (including Sheltered English Instruction / SIOP as a service model), assessment with ACCESS for ELLs, and reclassification. The guidebook is the canonical SEA-side companion to 14 DE Admin Code 1561/1562 for districts.

history.title: Refreshed against current SEA sources (verified-2026)
history.description: Re-verified 14 DE Admin Code 1561 (Bilingual Teacher) and 1562 (Teacher of English Learners), Delaware Professional Teaching Standards, the 2024 EL Guidebook, and NCES counts. Updated elPercent to 11.5% (NCES Fall 2021) and set bilingual.requirements.program=true, bilingual.requirements.test=true, eld.requirements.program=true, eld.requirements.languageProficiency=true to match current rule text.
